## Missing capability

What exact relation or behavior is missing? What question will it enable?

## Existing evidence and ownership

- Audited commit and relevant owner README/manifest/schema:
- Existing normalized relations, source evidence or preserved candidate:
- Canonical owner and downstream consumers:
- Join keys/namespaces, cardinality, conditions and unresolved boundary:
- Related issues/PRs and their currently verified dependency state:

## Bounded deliverable and checks

- [ ] Scope and exclusions are explicit; accepted corrections replace stale scope.
- [ ] Build/validation and meaningful missingness or corruption cases are specified.
- [ ] Catalog, owner documentation and applicable connection/inventory records update together.
- [ ] Source compatibility and any downstream pin/path migration are explicit.

Keep this proportional to the change; a small fix does not need a large audit essay.
